email.subject: AI for Jia Law Group, built for global practices like yours
email.body:
Hi Jason,

With offices spanning New York, the Netherlands, and France, Jia Law Group is navigating the kind of complexity that most firms never tackle. Managing global clients across multiple jurisdictions while staying lean takes precision.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with smaller teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: precision, client trust, and efficiency without the overhead.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to share how we're helping similar practices compete globally.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
